Jethalal wakes up in the middle of the night to drink water and spots a bearded silhouette lurking in the house. Panicking, he raises an alarm shouting "chor, chor!" which brings the entire Gokuldham society running to his house.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
